job.job_description:
We are looking for a strong Full Stack Engineer to build modern enterprise applications and integrate Generative AI, LLM and Agentic AI capabilities into production systems.

This is primarily an application engineering role with GenAI integration, not a traditional Data Science or ML model-development role.




Key Responsibilities

Design and develop scalable full-stack applications using:
Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL
Angular, Python, MS SQL Server
Build and integrate applications with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI APIs and LLM services.
Develop AI-enabled capabilities such as conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, RAG, agents and tool/function calling.
Build secure and scalable REST APIs, backend services and database integrations.
Integrate frontend, backend, databases and AI services into end-to-end enterprise solutions.
Collaborate with architecture, product and AI teams to take solutions from POC to production.
Follow software engineering best practices around security, scalability, testing and maintainability.



Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience with Next.js, Node.js, Angular and Python
Experience with PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server
Experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI
Strong understanding of REST APIs, full-stack application development and system integration
Working knowledge of Generative AI, LLMs, LangChain, LangGraph (prompting, tools, orchestration concepts, stateful workflows) and Microsoft Agent Framework or MCP



Good-to-Have Skills

Knowledge of Azure AI Search, vector databases and GenAI observability/evaluation
Experience with Docker, CI/CD, Entra ID and Azure deployment services
